sloka: तां तु दृष्ट्वा तथाभूतां तृणविन्दुरथाब्रवीत् ।किं त्वमेतत्त्वसदृशं धारयस्यात्मनो वपुः ।। ७.२.१९ ॥
transliteration: tāṁ tu dṛṣṭvā tathābhūtāṁ tṛṇavindurathābravīt ।kiṁ tvametattvasadṛśaṁ dhārayasyātmano vapuḥ ।। 7.2.19 ॥

translations.english: Seeing her in such a transformed state, Tṛṇabindu then asked her why she was bearing a form so unbefitting her true self.
